reason: I already have my Toplux and I reorder it when it runs out, so I don't go looking for something new. One form of magnesium for about $30 feels like paying more for less when other brands put several forms in one capsule.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when others have 8 forms in one capsule? I don't see what I'm getting that my current one doesn't give me.
would_change_my_mind: A clear reason why bisglycinate alone beats a multi-form blend, plus a price closer to what I pay now, like $20 or less for 30 days.
